input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including app user, app user role. The platform provides capabilities for my user details, user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage app user records, so that I can track and organize app user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage app user role records, so that I can track and organize app user role data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with global exception handler functionality, so that I can accomplish my global exception handler-related tasks.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
